name: Mushroom Omelet
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: large button mushrooms
ingredients.originalText: a cupful of large button mushrooms

ingredients.name: half a cupful of cream or milk
ingredients.originalText: half a cupful of cream or milk
ingredients.quantityText: half a cupful of cream or milk

instructions.text: Clean a cupful of large button mushrooms, canned ones may be used
Put into a stewpan an ounce of butter and let it melt
Add the mushrooms, a teaspoonful of salt, half a teaspoonful of pepper and half a cupful of cream or milk
Stir in a teaspoonful of flour, dissolved in a little milk or water to thicken, if needed
Boil ten minutes, and set aside until the omelet is ready
Make a plain omelet the usual way, and just before doubling it, turn the mushrooms over the centre and serve hot

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Clean a cupful of large button mushrooms, canned ones may be used
2. Cut them into bits
3. Put into a stewpan an ounce of butter and let it melt
4. Add the mushrooms, a teaspoonful of salt, half a teaspoonful of pepper and half a cupful of cream or milk
5. Stir in a teaspoonful of flour, dissolved in a little milk or water to thicken, if needed
6. Boil ten minutes, and set aside until the omelet is ready
7. Make a plain omelet the usual way, and just before doubling it, turn the mushrooms over the centre and serve hot
